data.name: Jubion
data.long_meaning: The name Jubion is derived from the Hebrew word ‘yubal’ which means ‘to rejoice’ or ‘to exult’. It is also linked to the Greek word ‘jubaeo’ meaning ‘to shout’ or ‘to cry out’ in joy. In the Bible, the name Jubal is given to the father of all musicians, highlighting the joyful and musical nature of this name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the joy and exultation found in the worship of God.
